skill.name: generate-sparkle-appcast
skill.description: Generate Mos Sparkle appcast files, localized release notes, and Ed25519 signatures from a prepared macOS release zip.
skill.summary: Automates Mos Sparkle appcast generation, release notes, and signing for stable or beta macOS releases.
skill.author: Caldis

security_audit.summary: Most static alerts are false positives from Markdown inline code, quoted shell substitutions, or URLs written into appcast metadata. Real risk remains because the script reads a Sparkle private key, decodes it, writes derived key files, and passes key material through process arguments. The script also allows optional release-note file paths that can copy arbitrary local files into docs/ for publishing.

remediation.issue: Sparkle private key material is passed as a Python command-line argument.
remediation.suggestion: Pass the key seed through stdin or a locked-down file descriptor instead of argv, and avoid exposing secrets in process listings.

remediation.issue: The script materializes decoded private key data as DER and PEM files in a temporary directory.
remediation.suggestion: Use umask 077 before creating key files, keep the temporary directory private, and prefer signing flows that avoid writing private keys to disk.

remediation.issue: RELEASE_NOTES_ZH_FILE and RELEASE_NOTES_EN_FILE can point to arbitrary source files that are copied into docs/.
remediation.suggestion: Resolve paths with realpath, require HTML files under an approved release-notes directory, and reject paths outside the repository.

remediation.issue: The release script depends on git, Python, OpenSSL, filesystem writes, and local signing credentials.
remediation.suggestion: Document the trust boundary clearly and run the skill only in the intended Mos release repository with reviewed inputs.

semantic_findings.title: Private Key Material Passed Through Process Arguments
semantic_findings.description: The script reads the Sparkle private key into key_b64 and passes it to Python as a command-line argument before decoding it. Local process listings can expose argv values to other same-host users or tooling.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The key is read from sparkle_private_key.txt into key_b64 and then supplied as sys.argv[1] to Python. That is clear evidence of private key material traveling through process arguments.

semantic_findings.title: User-Controlled Release Note Paths Can Publish Local Files
semantic_findings.description: RELEASE_NOTES_ZH_FILE and RELEASE_NOTES_EN_FILE can point to arbitrary files, and the script copies those files into docs/release-notes by basename. A bad or injected environment value could publish unintended local content.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The environment-controlled source paths are not restricted to build/release-notes before copy. Exploitation requires control of those environment variables, so confidence is high but not absolute.

content.user_title: Generate Sparkle Appcasts for Mos Releases
content.value_statement: Publishing Mos updates requires signed appcast files, localized release notes, and matching release assets. This skill automates those release steps from a prepared macOS zip and recent git history.
actual_capabilities: Finds the newest Mos release zip in the build directory.
Parses stable and beta version data from Mos zip filenames.
Reads app version metadata from the zipped macOS app bundle.
Generates Chinese and English release notes from recent git commits.
Creates a Sparkle Ed25519 signature for the selected zip.
Writes appcast and release-note files into build and docs directories.
limitations: Only supports the Mos filename format documented by the skill.
Requires a local Sparkle Ed25519 private key file before signing.
Requires git, Python 3, and OpenSSL on the release machine.
Does not create or upload the GitHub Release asset.

use_cases.title: Prepare a Stable Mos Release
use_cases.description: Generate the signed appcast and hosted release notes after a notarized stable zip is placed in build/.

use_cases.title: Publish a Beta Update Feed
use_cases.description: Create beta-channel Sparkle metadata when the release zip uses the documented beta filename format.

use_cases.title: Refresh Localized Release Notes
use_cases.description: Build Chinese and English release-note pages from git changes since the previous release commit.

prompt_templates.title: Generate a Basic Appcast
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner release run with a known previous commit.
prompt_templates.prompt: Generate the Mos Sparkle appcast using the latest zip in build/ and use the previous release commit abc123 as the since commit.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Beta Appcast
prompt_templates.scenario: Beta release where the zip already includes the beta filename marker.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the generate-sparkle-appcast skill to prepare the beta appcast and localized release notes for the latest Mos beta zip.

prompt_templates.title: Use Existing Release Notes
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate workflow with prewritten Chinese and English notes.
prompt_templates.prompt: Generate the appcast with my prewritten Chinese and English release-note HTML files, then copy the final outputs into docs/.

prompt_templates.title: Verify Release Metadata
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced release check before publishing a GitHub Release.
prompt_templates.prompt: Generate the appcast, then verify the tag, asset name, version metadata, release-note URLs, and Sparkle signature all match the selected zip.

output_examples.input: A stable Mos zip, a valid Sparkle private key, and a previous release commit.
output_examples.output: A signed appcast file is written to build and docs, with matching Chinese and English release-note pages.

output_examples.input: A beta Mos zip with recent user-facing git changes.
output_examples.output: A beta-channel update item is generated with localized notes and a GitHub release download URL.

output_examples.input: Prewritten release-note pages supplied through environment variables.
output_examples.output: The supplied notes are reused and copied into the publishing directory with matching appcast links.

best_practices: Run the skill only from the intended Mos release repository.
Keep the Sparkle private key outside version control with strict local permissions.
Confirm the GitHub Release tag and asset name match the generated appcast URL.
anti_patterns: Do not run the script with an unreviewed zip or unknown signing key.
Do not point release-note file variables at arbitrary local files.
Do not repack or re-sign the zip after generating the Sparkle signature.

faq.question: What does this skill generate?
faq.answer: It generates a Sparkle appcast, localized release-note pages, and a signature for a prepared Mos release zip.

faq.question: Does it upload files to GitHub?
faq.answer: No. It writes local build and docs files. The GitHub Release asset must still be created separately.

faq.question: Which release channels are supported?
faq.answer: It supports stable releases and beta releases when the zip filename uses the documented beta format.

faq.question: Why does it need a private key?
faq.answer: Sparkle uses the Ed25519 key to sign the update zip so clients can verify the download.

faq.question: Can I use custom release notes?
faq.answer: Yes. You can provide Chinese and English HTML files through environment variables before running the script.

faq.question: Is this safe to run in any repository?
faq.answer: No. It is tailored to the Mos repository layout and should run only in that trusted release environment.
